packageRules.description: Whiteboard pins are exact on purpose: a bump needs a deliberate re-probe of native Mermaid-to-Excalidraw conversion (the native-conversion test in test/whiteboard-render.browser.test.js, mermaid-to-excalidraw#108), and a converter bump must move the Excalidraw override in pnpm-workspace.yaml with it (test/whiteboard-pins.test.js). Converter 3.x no longer depends on mermaid, so mermaid is not a dependency any more. Keep them out of the auto-merged patch/minor group and list them on the Dependency Dashboard for approval.
